historicalRegister: parity-platform-audit.md section 10 (local unaccepted historical draft; exact IDs/scopes preserved below)
ownershipMeaning: Existing work-package responsibility, not live worker assignment or permission to dispatch before audit closure.
evidenceMeaning: Accepted bounded artifacts are reused; no identifier is declared runtime complete. Open review means no closure established in this reconciliation, not proof no implementation or other evidence exists.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: No repeat key census: 214 fields are allocated; 180 inherited consumer classifications retain semantic uncertainty under E2.
gaps.acceptance: Preserve every field, per-field override/migration and host authority behavior; execute persistence/restart and platform shortcut cases.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: Imported alias correction captures 28 GitLab methods/channels. No repeat missing-file claim; payload/handler semantics remain E3/provider work.
gaps.acceptance: Port provider assertions and compare request/result/error, authentication and unavailable-provider behavior without assuming GitHub equivalence.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: 24 assembled bridge methods are in the accepted census; this does not characterize every handler.
gaps.acceptance: Preserve Linear request/result/error and workspace/team selection behavior with source tests and rendered provider states.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: 59 assembled bridge methods are enumerated; not a full provider or CLI behavior proof.
gaps.acceptance: Trace host/client credential and gh-execution ownership, then compare provider success/error/disconnected states and source assertions.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: 87 assembly/type domains agree. Three usage factory exports remain explicit scanner unknowns; 24 factory-generated channel shapes have separate source characterization. 981 extracted methods are a bounded subset, not the full API denominator.
gaps.acceptance: Retain delegated/dynamic/factory entries and validate actual payload, subscription teardown, error and mixed-version contracts.

gaps.originalScope: Main-side ipcMain registry census previously truncated
gaps.enumerationDisposition: Bounded scanner covers 4579 main files; delegated main requests/sends and 94/96 missing push producers have later source traces. Two legacy producers remain unidentified. Current close/PDF paths are not those missing producers.
gaps.acceptance: Preserve unknown legacy receivers, close acknowledgement expiry/intent and payload/error/disposal contracts; test both version skews. Do not remove channels because a producer was not found.

gaps.originalScope: config/ keys, orca.yaml and headless serve flags
gaps.enumerationDisposition: serve registry and shared parser metadata exist; config/orca.yaml consumer precedence and serve execution need bounded source review. orcad options cannot substitute for serve.
gaps.acceptance: Produce config-schema/precedence/error and serve handler contracts, then source/candidate tests using isolated profiles and explicit network exposure.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: Existing file allocation is not a deployment/asset capability inventory. Reconcile packaging and cloud entrypoints, distribution surfaces and provenance; do not claim these are absent from the product.
gaps.acceptance: Verify package contents, licensing, installer/update/rollback, independent public deployment configuration and required cloud capabilities without copying private destinations or credentials.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: Nine crash bridge methods and local heap/process readers are known; this does not identify submission destinations, redaction or consent authority.
gaps.acceptance: Trace submission client/config/server and consent/redaction/retry contracts; test with fixture destinations, never send diagnostic data to upstream as an audit side effect.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: Reconcile actual asset selection and packaging branches per OS. Finding macOS template files is not evidence of Linux/Windows absence or parity.
gaps.acceptance: Record OS-specific icon selection, template/density/theme behavior and menu actions; validate packaged rendered tray on each supported OS.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: Seven bridge methods/channels are enumerated, including changed push. Dedicated file-backed KeybindingService is not GlobalSettings.keybindings authority.
gaps.acceptance: Preserve get/edit/reload/file/reveal and changed-event behavior, platform key labels/modifiers, dynamic harness bindings and restart persistence.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: Complete five-option parser plus entrypoint smoke flag reviewed. Historical data-root flag premise corrected: data root is environment selected. No port default inferred from empty options.
gaps.acceptance: Port launch assertions plus uncovered parse edges, validate native preflight, isolated data-root lock, readiness, error exits and bounded shutdown; distinguish PID-scoped from cgroup-wide restart.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: 615 runtime RPC names and a bounded relay error path are accepted; they do not establish the separate relay dispatcher method/notification/stream surface.
gaps.acceptance: Enumerate actual relay dispatch composition, auth, stream opcodes and parameter/error handling; preserve SSH ownership and both client/host version skews.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: Desktop mobile bridge (15 methods), wire constants and 532 allocated mobile test/support files are not the mobile client's outgoing RPC/subscription census.
gaps.acceptance: Reconcile mobile client adapters, methods/streams, capability gates, pairing/revocation and reconnect; port tests and verify against old/new host combinations.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: 12 built-ins and 10 local manifests are explicit; no repeated registry discovery. Custom user models are not inferred absent.
gaps.acceptance: Verify custom/built-in selection, credentials, download integrity/progress/cancel/retry/delete, native loading and actual transcription. Cloud product parity does not authorize cloud inference in the Spark-only benchmark.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: Ten preload methods are stream/UI-facing. The distinct EMULATOR_METHODS table already enumerates 19 RPCs including device management; fully read here. Runtime device effects and errors remain uncharacterized.
gaps.acceptance: Trace each runtime delegation and device/host selector; preserve schemas and execute source/candidate managed/unmanaged device, install/launch/permissions, shutdown, stream and recovery tests.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: Dashboard bridge (16 methods) and general settings persistence do not prove placement ownership, monitor reconciliation or popout lifecycle.
gaps.acceptance: Trace geometry/state persistence and cross-window identity; verify reopen, monitor loss/DPI, main/popout transitions and restart with rendered evidence.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: browser.readClientHostId argument reader and push producer linkage do not establish client-host lease acquisition, renewal, expiry or reassignment.
gaps.acceptance: Trace lease state/authority transitions across runtime and UI, then test disconnect/reconnect, expiry, concurrent ownership and stale-client refusal with both version skews.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: CLI show preserves undefined as unknown/not evaluated and null as none. Producer/transport/consumer plumbing beyond this formatter remains owed.
gaps.acceptance: Trace all transformations and assert missing, null and populated states through host RPC to CLI/UI, including older peers; never collapse unknown into none.

gaps.enumerationDisposition: Bounded relay error serialization/reconstruction and current phrase fallback documented; seven original in-memory classification cases pass. No actual SSH transport or candidate proof.
gaps.acceptance: Preserve old-host fallback; compare real transport error reconstruction and remote-path behavior in both version skews. Path-existence booleans are not process-liveness verdicts; structured errno extension is not assumed implemented.

upstreamMentuPolicy.phase: During implementation whenever a required Mentu capability is missing
upstreamMentuPolicy.action: Prepare minimal justified English upstream PRs with tests and Codex attribution; discuss material scope expansions. Build and test the pinned local PR revision without waiting for upstream merge.
upstreamMentuPolicy.acceptance: Validate actual Drogon/Pi integration and run records; model statements and PR existence are not functional proof. Comparative inference remains exclusively Pi + DGX Spark, with real token measurement; inference_budget enforcement is not required.
